title: ErrorCodesCatalogV1_2
description: Authoritative machine-readable error codes for the shared agent runtime.

errors.description: Requested contract major version is incompatible with the runtime.
Requested capability ID is not registered in the CapabilityRegistry.
Capability version specified in profile is incompatible with registered capability version.
Requested agent profile could not be found in the registry or loaded from disk.
Profile manifest violated schema, model constraints, or capability permissions.
Tool is not on the profile's allow-list (whitelist, allowed global capabilities, allowed local tools).
A policy rule denied the tool call (for example a local tool without local_tool_policy, or a write in plan mode before an approved plan).
A beforeToolCall decide hook denied the tool call.
A person answered the tool call's approval request with no.
The tool call needs a person's approval and none was given (no registered approval, or the approval expired unanswered).
Tool invocation lacked required application or session scope (app_id, session_id).
Concurrent execution in progress under the same idempotency key.
Run execution exceeded the allocated wall-clock deadline.
Run was explicitly cancelled via abort signal or cancellation endpoint.
Runtime execution of an authorized global capability failed.
Local application tool could not be admitted due to authorization or scoping error.
Shared agent runtime is unavailable or unreachable.
Payload failed validation against canonical CreateRunRequest schema.
